title.narrative: Service Academy Foreign Student Program - U.S. Military Academy

description.narrative: The U.S. Department of Defense's three service academies' (the U.S. Military Academy, the U.S. Naval Academy, the U.S. Air Force Academy) Foreign Student Program allows up to 60 foreign students to attend each Service Academy at any one time as actual members of an Academy class (e.g., as full-time, four-year degree candidates). These activities expose future foreign leaders, at the beginning of their careers, to their U.S. peers in an environment that is designed to promote military professionalism and appreciation of democratic values and civil society.
